clean.use_when: Formal decks, boards, anything that must stay square; also the baseline to compare against

editorial.use_when: Reports and talks with a point of view; a few slides laid out like a magazine page

swiss.use_when: Technical, data-led or design-minded decks; precise, quiet

organic.use_when: Warm, human subjects: wellbeing, culture, workshops

watercolour.use_when: Gentle, creative or care-related subjects; arts, education, health

papercut.use_when: Craft, stories and teaching; tactile, layered

paper.use_when: Workshops, ideas, drafts, education; squared paper and torn sheets

tech-dark.use_when: Product, engineering and security talks; modules and a grid

blueprint.use_when: Architecture, engineering, process and systems; precise drawn outlines

terminal.use_when: Developer and infrastructure audiences; steps stepping down like output

brutalist.use_when: Bold statements and manifestos; blunt blocks, a huge word on request

sketch.use_when: Brainstorms, discovery and early concepts; drawn by hand

collage.use_when: Creative, cultural or youth subjects; scraps pinned at different heights

retro-70s.use_when: Brand, culture and storytelling with a warm, nostalgic tone

bauhaus.use_when: Design and architecture; circles, blocks and a giant figure

rain.use_when: Reflective, serious or melancholy subjects; falling items, thin rain

sunny.use_when: Optimistic news, launches, summer events; open, round, warm light

nature.use_when: Sustainability, outdoors, food and wellbeing; pebbles and a soft wash
